attributes.action: Reinstate The Cheshire West Acid Test for Deprivation of Liberty
attributes.additional_details: The Supreme Court has overturned the Cheshire West acid test. We believe this risks reducing legal safeguards for people who lack mental capacity. The acid test provided a clear and consistent standard for identifying when restrictions on a person's freedom require independent scrutiny and legal authorisation. The Government should restore these protections in legislation.
attributes.background: We call on the Government to reinstate the Cheshire West "acid test" for determining whether a person is deprived of their liberty. The acid test provides a clear legal safeguard for people who lack capacity and are under continuous supervision and control and are not free to leave.
